name: What is commercial building construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Commercial building construction involves the design, planning, and erection of structures intended for business and industrial use, rather than residential. This includes offices, retail spaces, warehouses, restaurants, and other facilities that support commercial activities. Unlike residential projects, commercial construction often requires adherence to specific zoning laws, building codes, and accessibility standards tailored for public or employee access. The process typically involves a larger scale, specialized materials, and more complex regulatory compliance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Commercial building construction focuses on designing and erecting structures for business and industrial use, such as offices, retail, and warehouses. It involves specific zoning laws, building codes, and accessibility standards distinct from residential projects.
